title: Rizz Sound Effect
blurb: Certification audio for a successful display of charisma — the stamp that makes a smooth line official. Rizz, shortened from charisma and popularised by streamer Kai Cenat before Oxford named it word of the year in 2023, describes the ability to talk your way into something you had no business getting. TikTok plays this over confident walk-ups, unlikely flirting and negotiations that end in a phone number. It is arguably even better used ironically, laid over a catastrophic attempt that ended in visible pain. Both modes are essential to a working soundboard.
origin: TikTok's certification sound for displays of rizz (charisma), ironic or sincere.
